verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents only an MCP server (https://app.puzzle.io/mcp) that external assistants such as Claude connect to. That is the opposite direction from this story and earns no credit here. Puzzle does ship built-in AI agents (AI Close, Accounting AI), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question, but nothing in the pack shows it can act as an MCP client and consume tools from user-supplied servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
